title: PV-BESS-Gym: a market-sequenced Gymnasium benchmark for solar-plus-storage in the Greek electricity market

creators.name: Korkas, Christos D.
creators.affiliation: Power & Energy Systems Laboratory, University of Western Macedonia

description: Gymnasium environment, perfect-foresight oracle, benchmark protocol and baselines (rule-based, MPC, PPO, SAC, PPO with a safety projection layer) for day-ahead, intraday, aFRR and real-time operation of a PV-plus-battery plant in the Greek electricity market. Market data are not redistributed; the repository contains the scripts that rebuild the dataset from HEnEx, IPTO and Open-Meteo publications.
